definitions.explanation: A type of small bamboo with broad leaves, used for wrapping food and in traditional decorations.

examples.japanese: {笹|ささ}の{葉|は}に{短冊|たんざく}を{吊|つ}るした。
examples.english: I hung paper strips on bamboo grass leaves.

examples.japanese: {笹団子|ささだんご}は{新潟|にいがた}の{名物|めいぶつ}だ。
examples.english: Sasadango (rice dumplings wrapped in bamboo grass) is a specialty of Niigata.

examples.japanese: パンダは{笹|ささ}を{食|た}べる。

notes:
{笹|ささ} refers to sasa bamboo grass, smaller than regular bamboo.

Common uses:
- {笹|ささ}の{葉|は} (bamboo grass leaves)
- {笹飾|ささかざ}り (Tanabata decorations)
- {笹団子|ささだんご} (rice dumplings wrapped in bamboo grass)
- {笹|ささ}かまぼこ (bamboo leaf-shaped fish cake from Sendai)
- {笹寿司|ささずし} (sushi wrapped in bamboo grass leaves)

Counter: {本|ほん}

Cultural note:
{笹|ささ} is central to {七夕|たなばた} (Tanabata) celebrations, where wishes written on {短冊|たんざく} (paper strips) are hung on bamboo grass branches. {笹|ささ}の{葉|は} has antimicrobial properties and has been used to wrap food for centuries. Unlike regular bamboo ({竹|たけ}), {笹|ささ} stays small and has broader leaves.
